error[ZC-E0217]: this zcube-server was built without that store
  cause  this zcube-server has no postgres store; it was built with memory and
         sqlite
  fix    name a store this server has, or install the server package for postgres (zigcube-server-postgres)
  more   zcube explain E0217 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigcube/errors/E0217.html
